title: Admiral Lloyd R. "Joe" Vasey Pacific War Commemorative Display Establishment Act
official_summary:
Admiral Lloyd R. "Joe" Vasey Pacific War Commemorative Display Establishment Act

(Sec. 4) This bill authorizes the Pacific Historic Parks to establish and maintain a commemorative display to honor the members of the U.S. Armed Forces and Allies who served in the Pacific Theater during World War II. Federal funds may not be used to design, procure, prepare, install, or maintain the commemorative display, but the National Park Service may accept and expend contributions of non-Federal funds and resources for such purposes.
